programs.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programs.desc: Join Tianran and Hannah in Shantou, Guangdong, as they explore the world of kungfu tea and its inseparable link to the local food. After sampling the finest teas the old city has to offer, they’ll try their hand at traditional crafts like inlaid porcelain and red peach pastries, all while taking in Shantou's coastal scenery and vibrant culture.

programs.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programs.desc: This time Tianran and Hannah are in the scenic city of Shaoguan in northern Guangdong, where northern and southern culinary traditions converge. There, they’ll sample rare teas from the Danxia landscape, savor mountain-grown dishes, and visit the great Hakka enclosures, learning how the history of migration has shaped the way people eat and drink. After trying their hand at making ancient-style rice noodles, they end their journey at a thousand-year-old temple, where the spirit of Zen tea brings their exploration to a peaceful close.

programs.title: Lancang-Mekong: The River That Flows South Ep.3
programs.desc: This documentary follows 24 families along the Lancang-Mekong River—their lives, their connections, and the quiet ways they remain independent yet bound to one another. What emerges is a portrait of shared wisdom, shaped by the river and passed down for generations.

programs.title: The Call of Glaciers
programs.desc: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is one of the world's most climate-sensitive regions. As its indigenous peoples, animals, and plants face the impacts of climate change, a Gen Z environmentalist rediscovers her homeland, with plenty of new insight along the way.
